title: HELP_REGISTRY completeness (an entry for every switch case) is enforced only by…
description:
HELP_REGISTRY completeness (an entry for every switch case) is enforced only by a code comment. Consider a compile-time exhaustiveness check (e.g. keying the registry off a Command string-literal union used by the switch) so a future command that omits its entry fails typecheck instead of silently re-opening the --help footgun this story closed.

Source: cam/issue-211
Review round: 1
Location: index.ts:2083

suggestion-fingerprint: 327d3af82b10

spec.scope: Compile-time exhaustiveness for the CLI command set. Introduce a single COMMANDS source-of-truth (const array as const -> Command string-literal union), retype HELP_REGISTRY from Record<string,string> to Record<Command,string>, narrow argv[2] to Command before the dispatch switch, and add an exhaustive default: never so a command added without a help entry OR without a switch case fails typecheck. No behavior change for valid commands; the unknown-command path and pre-switch special cases are preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: A single source of truth for command names exists (e.g. `const COMMANDS = [...] as const` deriving `type Command = typeof COMMANDS[number]`) enumerating all 25 current commands, including the internal/hidden ones (sidecar, orch-recycle-watch, sidecar-liveness-watch, retry-monitor) that the comment at index.ts:2131-2138 requires.
HELP_REGISTRY is retyped from Record<string,string> to Record<Command,string> (index.ts:2139); typecheck fails if any Command lacks an entry or an entry uses a non-Command key.

The dispatch switch (index.ts:2215) narrows argv[2] to Command before switching and has an exhaustive `default: const _never: never = command;` so a Command added to COMMANDS without a switch case fails typecheck.

Unknown/invalid argv[2] (not in COMMANDS) is handled BEFORE the switch, preserving the current unknown-command message and exit behavior (previously index.ts:2540 default); the pre-switch special-case handling (e.g. command === 'claude' at index.ts:2178) keeps working.

The enforcement is real, not cosmetic: removing a HELP_REGISTRY entry OR a switch case for an existing command causes bun run typecheck to fail. Demonstrate this (temporary deletion reverted, or a comment noting the observed failure).
No behavior change for any valid command's --help output or dispatch. bun run typecheck, bun test, bun run check:all all green.
gotchas: Command names are currently TRIPLICATED: switch case labels (index.ts:2216-2527), HELP_REGISTRY keys (index.ts:2140-2164), and pre-switch special-case checks (command === 'claude' at index.ts:2178, and similar). Route all of them through the single COMMANDS source; do not leave a 4th independent copy.

The switch keys on argv[2]: string today; the exhaustive `default: never` only type-checks after argv[2] is narrowed to Command. Narrowing (a COMMANDS.includes guard or `is Command`) must run before the switch, and the unknown-command branch must move ahead of the switch so genuinely-unknown input is still handled gracefully.

Internal/hidden commands (sidecar, orch-recycle-watch, sidecar-liveness-watch, retry-monitor) MUST remain in COMMANDS and HELP_REGISTRY by design (index.ts:2131-2138). Do not drop them to make the union smaller.
KEYBAR_COMMANDS in src/ui/Dashboard.tsx:103 is unrelated dashboard-keybar UI, not the CLI command set; do not conflate or reuse it.
Keep the existing *_HELP string constants as the registry values; only the registry key type and the source-of-truth array change.
